briefing.headline: BOMET TOWN 2026-07-01 is severely under-controlled: stocktakes unfinished, ingredient usage almost entirely unrecorded, and a KES 13,656 BOM cost gap makes the day's numbers unreliable.
briefing.food_cost_assessment: Recorded food cost is only 4.6% against a 30% target, but this is misleading — only KES 4,696 of an expected KES 18,352 in ingredient cost was captured. The gap is not efficiency; it is missing stocktake data. Key ingredients AJAB UGALI (KES 5,499), MILK PACKET (KES 4,631), BROILERS (KES 1,500), and POTATOES (KES 1,167) show zero actual usage recorded against real POS sales.

top_concerns.title: Kitchen stocktakes not approved — both shifts still 'submitted'
top_concerns.explanation: Shift A (419.66 unit net variance) and Shift B (133.4 unit net variance) are submitted but not approved, meaning ingredient consumption figures are unverified and the day is not closed.
top_concerns.action: Kitchen supervisor and accountant must review and approve or reject both stocktake shifts first thing tomorrow.

top_concerns.title: Zero actual usage recorded for top ingredients worth KES 12,629 theoretical cost
top_concerns.explanation: AJAB UGALI (20.75 KG, KES 5,499), MILK PACKET (7.125 L, KES 4,631), POTATOES (23.33 KG, KES 1,167), and MINCED MEAT (0.442 KG, KES 301) all show zero actual recorded usage despite confirmed POS sales requiring them.
top_concerns.action: Storekeeper JAMES PKEMOI must reconcile and re-enter actual consumption for these items against the approved stocktake before the day is closed.

top_concerns.title: Kitchen shift ledger: KES 1,590 unexplained AJAB UGALI loss
top_concerns.explanation: AJAB UGALI opened at 6 KG, nothing was added, sold, or counted — the entire 6 KG (KES 1,590) is unaccounted for with no physical count recorded (null).
top_concerns.action: Demand a written explanation from the storekeeper and kitchen team for the 6 KG AJAB UGALI with no physical count and no sale record.

top_concerns.title: Bar POS vs stock ledger gap of 8 units
top_concerns.explanation: POS recorded 270 bar drinks sold but the bar stock ledger net deduction is 278 units — an 8-unit discrepancy suggesting either unlinked drink SKUs or reversal-posting errors.
top_concerns.action: Bar supervisor should reconcile the 16 sale-reversal entries (28 units) against POS voided items and confirm all drinks are correctly linked to inventory.

top_concerns.title: No cashier shift opened — KES 186,520 total revenue unreconciled
top_concerns.explanation: Zero cashier shifts were recorded against KES 186,520 in POS revenue (restaurant KES 102,270 + bar KES 84,250), so cash collection cannot be verified for the day.
top_concerns.action: Accountant must open, complete, and close the cashier reconciliation for 2026-07-01 immediately and account for all cash collected.

wins: Bar stocktake was completed (117 records), all 17 non-zero variances were reviewed and approved with reasons, and pending_review count is zero.
Pastry production and issue are fully balanced: 114 units produced, 114 issued to kitchen, matching PASTRY_PRODUCTION and PASTRY_ISSUE_TO_KITCHEN movements exactly.
Bar revenue of KES 84,250 from 270 POS transactions is captured and the stocktake is closed — bar tier is the most complete control point today.
data_quality_notes: With 40 menu items sold having no recipe (e.g. Mbuzi Wet Fry, KCC Milk Packet, Minute Maid, Water 500ml), theoretical cost is materially understated — true food cost % cannot be calculated until recipes are built.

All production mismatches show produced=0 for every item including Tea Mug (114 sold), Ugali White (81), Chapati (77) — production recording is not being used at all, so produced-vs-sold analysis is meaningless until the team starts logging production.

Branch setup score is 18/100: all active menu items are missing cost prices, 9 items cannot track stock, and 15 recipe ingredients are unlinked to inventory — any cost figures produced today are partial at best.
